sections.title: Risk Factors
sections.excerpt: RISK FACTORS An investment by TriCo’s shareholders in First Hawaiian common stock as a result of the exchange of shares of TriCo common stock for shares of First Hawaiian common stock in the merger involves certain risks. Similarly, a decision on the part of First Hawaiian stockholders to approve the First Hawaiian share issuance also involves risks for First Hawaiian stockholders, who will continue to hold their shares of First Hawaiian common stock after the mergers. Certain material risks and uncertainties connected with the merger agreement and transactions contemplated thereby, including the mergers and bank merger, and ownership of First Hawaiian common stock are discussed below.
